entities.name: Web3D Consortium
entities.note: The non-profit organization that develops and maintains the X3D standard.

entities.name: X3D
entities.note: The ISO standard XML-based file format for representing 3D computer graphics.

entities.name: X3D 4.0
entities.note: The latest major version of the X3D standard, deeply integrating with HTML5.

entities.name: VRML
entities.note: Virtual Reality Modeling Language, the predecessor to X3D.

entities.name: X_ITE
entities.note: A WebGL-based X3D and VRML player written in JavaScript.

entities.name: Cobweb
entities.note: The predecessor to X_ITE, an earlier WebGL X3D browser.

entities.name: Holger Seelig
entities.note: The primary author and maintainer of X_ITE and Titania.

entities.name: WebGL
entities.note: A JavaScript API for rendering interactive 2D and 3D graphics.

entities.name: JavaScript
entities.note: The programming language of the Web, used by X3DOM and X_ITE.

entities.name: Titania
entities.note: A cross-platform 3D editor for X3D authored by Holger Seelig.

entities.name: X3DOM
entities.note: An open-source framework and runtime for integrating X3D into HTML5 DOM.

entities.name: HTML5
entities.note: The standard markup language for documents designed to be displayed in a web browser.

entities.name: DOM
entities.note: The Document Object Model, an API for HTML and XML documents.

entities.name: Johannes Behr
entities.note: A key researcher at Fraunhofer IGD and primary architect of X3DOM.

entities.name: Fraunhofer IGD
entities.note: A German research institute that developed InstantReality and X3DOM.

entities.name: Castle Game Engine
entities.note: A cross-platform 3D and 2D game engine supporting X3D, written in Object Pascal.

entities.name: Michalis Kamburelis
entities.note: The creator and lead developer of the Castle Game Engine.

entities.name: Object Pascal
entities.note: The programming language used to develop Castle Game Engine.

entities.name: view3dscene
entities.note: A viewer for X3D and VRML models built on top of the Castle Game Engine.

entities.name: FreeWRL
entities.note: An open-source X3D and VRML browser written in C++.

entities.name: John Stewart
entities.note: A primary maintainer and developer of the FreeWRL project.

entities.name: C++
entities.note: A high-performance programming language used by FreeWRL, InstantReality, and H3DAPI.

entities.name: InstantReality
entities.note: A high-performance mixed reality framework and X3D player developed by Fraunhofer IGD.

entities.name: Xj3D
entities.note: An open-source X3D toolkit and runtime written in Java.

entities.name: Java
entities.note: The programming language used to develop the Xj3D runtime.

entities.name: Don Brutzman
entities.note: A key leader in the Web3D Consortium and contributor to Xj3D.

entities.name: Naval Postgraduate School
entities.note: An academic institution heavily involved in X3D research and Xj3D development.

entities.name: BS Contact
entities.note: A commercial high-performance X3D and VRML viewer by Bitmanagement.

entities.name: Bitmanagement Software
entities.note: A commercial software company that develops the BS Contact viewer.

entities.name: Octaga
entities.note: A commercial X3D player known for high-performance enterprise visualization.

entities.name: H3DAPI
entities.note: An open-source, haptics-focused X3D framework written in C++.

entities.name: SenseGraphics
entities.note: The company that maintains the H3DAPI haptics framework.
